tagline: XPEL is the leading supplier of protective films, coatings and related services for automotive and architectural applications.
hero_kpi_rationale: Total revenue is the primary indicator of the company's growth, reflecting demand for its paint protection films and related services in the automotive and architectural markets.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue represents all product and service sales generated by the company.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin indicates the profitability of products and services before accounting for other operating expenses.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Operating income divided by total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin measures the profitability of the company's core operations.

kpis.name: Paint Protection Film Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of paint protection films for automotive applications.
kpis.description: This segment represents the company's core business and shows sustained demand.

kpis.name: Window Film Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of window films for automotive and architectural applications.
kpis.description: This segment benefits from increasing adoption of window films in the automotive and architectural sectors.
kpis.signal: Dynamic growth in the window film market.

kpis.name: Installation Services Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from film installation services provided through company-owned centers and dealer networks.
kpis.description: Growth in installation revenue reflects overall business expansion and the growing service network with dealerships.

kpis.name: China Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated in the Chinese market, including direct sales following the acquisition of the distributor in 2025.
kpis.description: The Chinese market represents a major growth driver for the company, with rapid product adoption and integration of direct distribution.

kpis.name: EBITDA
kpis.explanation: Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization.
kpis.description: EBITDA is a key indicator of the company's operating performance, unaffected by capital structure or non-recurring items.

kpis.name: Paint Protection Film Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of paint protection films for automotive applications.
kpis.description: This segment represents the company's core business and shows sustained demand.

kpis.name: Window Film Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from the sale of window films for automotive and architectural applications.
kpis.description: This segment benefits from increasing adoption of window films in the automotive and architectural sectors.
kpis.signal: Dynamic growth in the window film market.

kpis.name: China Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated in the Chinese market, including direct sales following the acquisition of the distributor in 2025.
kpis.description: The Chinese market represents a major growth driver for the company, with rapid product adoption and integration of direct distribution.

risks.title: Supply Chain and Manufacturing Disruptions
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned at the beginning of the risk factors section and repeated multiple times, highlighting the potential impact on the ability to meet demand and on costs. Dependence on sole suppliers and global events increases severity.

risks.title: Trade Policy and Customs Tariff Risks
risks.score_rationale: This risk is detailed in the risk factors section and highlights the uncertainty of customs tariffs' impact on consumer demand and supply chains. Potential government actions and retaliatory measures create high volatility.

risks.title: Regulatory and Compliance Risks in China
risks.score_rationale: This risk is specifically tied to operations in China, a geographically growing market representing 8.4% of 2025 revenue. The complexity and potential intervention by the Chinese government are noted as potentially material.

risks.title: Dependence on and Management of Key Personnel
risks.score_rationale: The risk factors section mentions reliance on key executives and the difficulty in attracting and retaining qualified personnel amid growth. Loss of such individuals could disrupt operations.

ai_positioning.summary: XPEL operates in the automotive and architectural protective films sector. The 10-K filing does not mention any involvement or strategy related to artificial intelligence.
